subject: website
name: DecentraWiki guide
summary: The guide to DecentraWiki, itself a TiddlyWiki wiki published on IPFS. Its source is public, and the page is its own readable source: the TiddlyWiki core beside it is unminified. It loads only its two files and sends no request of its own; links to other sites are links only. Its pen hands the wiki to the DecentraWiki editor inside the browser, with postMessage, and nothing goes over the network. Level 4 with privacy.

operations.name: Read the wiki
operations.note: Every page is in the files Orivon checked against the address; nothing else is fetched.

operations.name: Hand the wiki to the editor (the pen)
operations.note: The tiddlers go to the editor tab it opened, inside the browser; no network request is made.
